points: Bring a large saucepan of water with ½ tsp salt to the boil on high heat for the potatoes. Remove the steaks from your fridge to allow them to come up to room temperature.
Halve the salad potatoes (no need to peel).
When boiling, add the potatoes to the water, lower the heat to medium and cook until tender, 15-20 mins. Once cooked, drain in a colander.
steps.title: Cook the Potatoes

points: Meanwhile, trim the baby gem, separate the leaves, then tear into bite-sized pieces.
Trim the cucumber, then halve lengthways. Cut into 1cm thick half moons.
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
steps.title: Finish the Prep

points: In a medium bowl, combine the aioli, lemon juice, half the hard Italian style cheese and half the mustard.
Add the water for the dressing and honey (see pantry for both amounts).
Season with salt and pepper, then mix together.
steps.title: Make the Dressing

points: Once the potatoes are drained, pop them back in the pan and add a knob of butter (if you have any), the lemon zest and garlic.
Season with salt and pepper and mix together, cover with a lid and set aside.
steps.title: Toss Together

points: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on high heat. Season the steaks with salt and pepper.
Once very hot, lay the steaks into the pan and fry until browned and medium-rare, about 6-8 mins depending on their thickness. Turn halfway through.
Once cooked, transfer to a board, cover with foil and allow to rest for a couple of mins.

notes.text: Cook each side for 1 min more if you like it more well done
Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw meat. The steak is safe to eat when browned on the outside

steps.title: Fry your Steak

points: Add the lettuce and cucumber to your bowl of Caesar dressing and toss to coat.
Serve the steak with the garlic potatoes and Caesar salad alongside. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the salad.
Add a dollop of your remaining mustard alongside the steak.
steps.title: Finish and Serve
